text: also there needs to be a way better way to copy and paste outliners. duplicate button works but its 300+ pixels away and that distance adds up
resolution: Added focused model-outliner keyboard duplication: Ctrl+C records the current part selection, Ctrl+V duplicates it through the existing host-resident paint-carrying duplicate path, and Ctrl+D duplicates immediately. The shortcuts are surfaced in the outliner header and do not shuttle geometry through the JS clipboard.
